value.rationale: The degree-two harmonic Fourier cutoff is the first genuinely mixed second-harmonic testbed for the open planar h2-to-b4 nonlinear inclusion. It has a nontrivial global reflection-symmetrization lemma, a sharp algebraic operator constant and an exhaustive complex equality classification, suitable as a precise finite-band benchmark. The exact degree-two profile increases from the degree-one sharp fourth-power constant 7/6 to 1.349833...; no unrestricted bound is claimed.
